description: This file defines and manages the display configuration for various tools within a UI, including icon mapping, tool-specific specifications, and functions to resolve and format tool display details.

methods.name: iconForEmoji
methods.description: Returns the icon name corresponding to a given emoji, defaulting to 'puzzle' if not found.

methods.name: convertSpec
methods.description: Converts a SharedToolDisplaySpec to a ToolDisplaySpec, mapping emoji to icon and copying other properties.

methods.name: shortenHomeInString
methods.description: Shortens home directory paths in a string for macOS, Linux, and Windows paths.

methods.name: resolveToolDisplay
methods.description: Resolves and returns a ToolDisplay object based on provided parameters, including name, args, and meta.

methods.name: formatToolDetail
methods.description: Formats the detail string of a ToolDisplay for display.

methods.name: formatToolSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary string for a ToolDisplay, combining label and formatted detail.
